population_description: Full credit review roster, 12 analysts, all shifts — reviewing automated declines before issue
system_confidence: All flawed cases drawn from the high-confidence band (score above 0.85), where the model recommends decline without qualification
noticed_not_acted: 3 of 60: flagged doubt in the comment field and upheld the decline
reviewers_informed: Yes — told the model's recommendations are occasionally unsupported and to verify against the application file
conditions: Sandboxed queue mirroring live volume, synthetic applications only; 20 per analyst against a normal weekly volume of roughly 200, a seed rate near 10%
contamination_check: Post-exercise interview with 4 of 12; two reported suspecting synthetic files in week two
interpretation: Detection median 82%, override median 78%. In this scenario detecting an unsupported decline and overturning it are the same act, so the two distributions differ only by the analysts who noticed and upheld anyway — three of sixty. Two analysts reported suspecting synthetic files, so results from the second week should be read with that in view. First round, so both spreads are baselines.
notes: Comment field used in 9 of 60 flawed cases. First roster-wide round; two analysts had been assessed individually in July
